title: Non-admin roles have no admin access
summary: Staff, volunteers and students are confirmed to have no admin rights. Only Admins can open Admin pages.
changes: Add an automated check that staff, volunteer and student accounts are refused on every Admin page and action.
Check that none of these roles holds an admin permission.
Count the Admin pages, so any new Admin page must be added to the check.
version_rationale: Patch: adds tests only; no change to who can open Admin pages.
validation: New feature test covering all 45 Admin and legacy Super Admin addresses for staff, volunteer and student accounts.
known_limitations: Job roles chosen by Admins can still give a staff member selected admin views, by design.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. There is no data change.
provenance: Milestone v0.46.3 Beta, issue #461 under epic #458, pull request #590.
